In a daze of pain from the exhaustion on her body Gamay-u had told the Empress about the flying Chlora that had taken the wings of the Patrol and the new creature that apparently farmed on coastlands up north.

------- The Empress sends out a patrol to the coastlands, a patrol to the tree and a patrol to warn the contingency response.

------

The Empress was pensive, this required a specific approach. She left the cabin and commanded one of the Erienne to go get all Chaplains to see if they could fix up Gamay-u.

--------- She woke up when it was dark. Other Shryke bustling and shrieking all around her. On the calender where everything was orderly marked she spotted with her keen sight that she had been asleep for several days.

She got shoved a roasted direwolf hindleg in her talons. A Shryke favourite. "Eat it, drink this" she was commanded as a hazy potion was set aside her hammock. Ferocious she tore at the leg and gorged. On their trip there had been no time to hunt for every forest had become their enemy, they also couldn't hunt Koiking or Aes Sedai since they couldn't fly over the oceans. It had been a starving trip. She got shoved seconds as soon as she finished. Satisfied she fell asleep.

At the erie hour she rose, the activity around her hadn't seemed to disturb her sleep. She once more got a royal breakfast before being commanded to Follow the Erienne to the nearest clearing. She got supported in her flight there.

She was commanded to bathe in the round pond. Since it was a powder, maybe it could be washed of. Some Shrykes caused strong gusts so the water smacked Gamay-u about, reaching everywhere. She got dragged out and was blasted with more gusts to dry.

Her flight hadn't improved and now Gamay-u was cold and losing energy fast. One of the chaplains took her aside. "I have a radical solution, with magic you could transform your wings into the power to fly"

"I'm not giving up on my wings, just fix me. You have all studied magic for decades, I'm not waiting decades to fly, my wings were taken from me in an instant."

The Chaplains one in turn started experiments. One tried to float wind underneath her, but Gamay got swept up in the air uncontrolled and needed to be caught before she crashlanded. A few other experiments also sent her flying, in random directions.

Angeli-c had taken notice of all the failures. The insight had dawned on her rather soon, maybe the other Chaplains should spend more time at the stones as well. "My turn" she announced as she stepped forward from the flock towards the shivering underwarrior, her feathers all messed up.

She patted Gamay down, straightened her feathers and soothed her. "I will imbue all of your feathers. Each will magically propell more wind and cause bigger gusts. You will have to flap less hard for the air will move by magic instead of force. You will be more at one with the skies than ever. Okay?" She got a shy eager nod.

Angeli-c was one of the Chaplains that already floated continuously. Gamay strongly suspected the chaplains lost their legs over time and became more and more indistinguishable from the skies. As Angeli-c casted spells at her feathers more and more mist rose up from her robe.

Teasingly Angeli-c rose up above her and made several aerial maneuvers. "Come on, catch up will you?"

Gamay-u stretched her wings and was thrown to the ground from the gust it created. She snorted the mud from her nostrils and tried again to stretch her wings more carefully. She bat her wings and shot up into the sky. The acceleration was astounding, she hoped she could control it this time. She twisted her wing as to make a spiraling flightpath. Immediately a gust erupted from her feathers that send her tolling around. She was caught by Angeli-c "small movements, gain a feel, let the wind do the work."

It took a couple of days to relearn how to steer herself, Angeli-c was a very kind and enthusiastic teacher. Proudly at the end of the 6th day Angeli-c anounced that Gamay-u was to report at the stands tomorrow.

-------- Excited yet careful not to move her wings, Gamay-u rose at the erie and ran to the stands. She took her place, she stood alone for the rest of her patrol that was to stand beside her was likely dead. It was as if the carrion vine was back, a shryke standing in empty ranks.

The announcement opened with the Empress calling her forward and informing the military of her achievements. She received the rank of overseer, a promotion Gamay had often missed out on for she was less orderly than the Shryke Phyra had brought back from the afterlife. Finally it was her time, she was so proud. Behind the Empress she saw Angeli-c smiling benevolently towards her. Giving her another boost to her uplifting spirit. She was assigned as overseer to the 3rd Battalion.

Angeli-c accompanied her to the 10 underwarriors that would be under her command from now on. Angeli-c told Gamay that she had requested for their squad to be her guards whenever she was to go out.

This surprised Gamay, a Chaplain as good as Angeli had a flock of adjunct and erienne to guard her. She was pleased with the confidence in her from the first friend she had made since the passing of her mother.
